title: Mamba.forward casts inputs using cached self.dtype — wrong dtype after FSDP wraps the conv1d weight
trigger_conditions: Mamba sequence mixer wrapped in FSDP / FSDP2
Mixed-precision params (e.g., bf16 weights, fp32 cast targets)
root_cause: Mamba.forward used self.dtype (snapshot at construction time) to cast x. After FSDP wrapped the inner conv1d, the actual parameter dtype changed but self.dtype was stale, so x flowed into the kernel in the wrong precision. The MambaSSM kernel still ran but produced silently wrong values.
invariant: Activation dtype entering Mamba.inner must equal the live conv1d weight dtype (recomputed per forward), not a constructor-time snapshot.
diff_summary: Recompute dtype = self.inner.conv1d.weight.dtype inside forward and cast x to that live dtype.
